def process_datasets(datasets, key_prefix, min_value, max_value):
    """
    Process a list of datasets (pandas DataFrames), adding a new column with
    random values in [min_value, max_value) to each. The new column name is
    unique per dataset: {key_prefix}_{index}.

    Raises TypeError if any dataset is not a pandas DataFrame.
    """
    updated = []
    for i, dataset in enumerate(datasets):
        if not isinstance(dataset, pd.DataFrame):
            raise TypeError(
                f"Dataset at index {i} is not a pandas DataFrame "
                f"(got {type(dataset).__name__})"
            )
        new_col_name = f"{key_prefix}_{i}"
        # Ensure the column name is unique within this dataset
        base_name = new_col_name
        suffix = 1
        while new_col_name in dataset.columns:
            new_col_name = f"{base_name}_{suffix}"
            suffix += 1
        dataset = dataset.copy()
        dataset[new_col_name] = np.random.uniform(min_value, max_value, size=len(dataset))
        updated.append(dataset)
    return updated
